descriptor.retrieval_description: Metallic cylindrical combination lock body with smooth, dry, nonporous lateral surfaces and curved geometry. The intended contact region has no visible contamination, but features a raised dial on the front face.
descriptor.contact_region: Left and right lateral curved cylindrical surfaces of the lock body.
descriptor.local_geometry: Curved cylindrical surface with continuous curvature on the sides.
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: Clearly visible on the lateral sides.
descriptor.uncertainty: The rear side of the lock body is not visible in the image.
